changelog: **In-app bug & feedback reports, phase 1 (#3130, epic #3129):** a floating feedback button on every signed-in screen (`FeedbackWidget`, mounted in `providers.tsx`) takes a DOM screenshot of the visible viewport on open (`modern-screenshot`; the panel is excluded and password / one-time-code / card / `data-private` / `.rr-block` fields are painted over in the copy), and sends type, optional 1–5 rating, description, attachments (drag & drop + paste) and a required contact choice to `POST /api/support/reports`. A browser-side collector (`src/lib/feedbackCollector.ts`) keeps the last 20 `console.error` / `window.onerror` / `unhandledrejection` entries and the last 20 failed `fetch` calls (method, masked URL, status, duration, `x-request-id`) in memory only — nothing leaves the tab before Send. Masking is ONE pure module, `src/lib/feedbackContext.ts` (query values, fragments, credentials, token path segments, bearer tokens, JWTs, `password=`-style pairs, e-mail addresses), run again on the server; version / env / user agent are stamped server-side. New tenant model `SupportReport` (in `TENANT_MODELS`, nullable `context` Json) + `SupportReportFile` (blobs, reached through the report); erasure deletes a person's reports, merge re-points them. Admin inbox `/admin/support/reports` (tab next to the conversation queue): filters by type, status, date range and reporter, sort; detail shows the screenshot in the lightbox, environment, console/network tabs and the triage status (`NEW → TRIAGED → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED | WONT_FIX`). ADMIN-only, org-scoped (another org's id is 404). Docs: `docs/feedback-reports.md`.

en: Found a problem? The new feedback button in the bottom-right corner sends the support team a screenshot and the technical details of the page in one go — passwords and other sensitive values are removed first.
tr: Bir sorun mu buldun? Sağ alttaki yeni geri bildirim butonu, destek ekibine ekran görüntüsünü ve sayfanın teknik ayrıntılarını tek seferde gönderir — parolalar ve diğer hassas değerler önce çıkarılır.
de: Ein Problem gefunden? Der neue Feedback-Button unten rechts schickt dem Support-Team einen Screenshot und die technischen Details der Seite in einem Schritt — Passwörter und andere sensible Werte werden vorher entfernt.
